<voice name='忠保' class='忠保' src='voice/md04/0201840b43'>
"There was a reason, wasn't there? There'd have to be, for someone like you to kill him."

//【忠保】
<voice name='忠保' class='忠保' src='voice/md06/0350270b43'>
//「その意味がどんなものかは聞きません。
//　今は……聞きたくないです」
"I won't ask why he died. I don't want to know. Not yet."

//　三者は別れた。
  And so the three go their separate ways.

One waits, patient, for the time to be right.<K>
<?>
And one marches onward, to see justice done.
